title: Business clarity
when: Business reports, architecture walkthroughs and pull request explainers
rules: Keep the camera locked while people read. Move only to reveal a specific relationship.
Use staged nodes and drawn connectors for technical explanations.
No repeating B-roll. Match the clip and source offset to the beat, or shorten the beat.
Inspect background footage with native text at the start, middle and end, including a phone-size frame. Blur alone does not establish readability.
